🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE: LIVE UNTIL 3 NOVEMBER! 🎃
👻 8 LIMITED Halloween pieces: Black Cat, Bat, Spider, Witch Hat, Ghost, Jack-o-Lantern, Cauldron and Grim Reaper. Gone for good after 3 November!
🕸️ New Pumpkin, Haunted and Reaper Lootboxes
💎 +25% gems on every gem pack
🦇 A haunted graveyard board with bats, mist, ghost coins and Halloween bots
💣 Pumpkin Bomb and ghosts in the match Shop

Ronopoly is the property board game on Roblox! Roll the dice, buy properties and tycoons, make trades and bankrupt your rivals to win.

🎲 Classic: 4-player matches
⚡ Mini: a fast 2-player board
👥 Custom matches with friends, including 2v2 and 3v3 teams, or fill seats with bots
✅ Daily and weekly Tasks for bonus XP
🏆 A new Season every month with fresh rewards
♟️ Collect and trade board pieces

👍 Like the game and join Late Shift Games for updates!
✏️ Found a bug or have an idea? Tap the pencil button in the menu.
